title: Preservation of Head Bounds
statement: Let $y$ be a Boolean input word and $c$ a configuration of the four-tape access machine on input $y$, with every work-tape head between $-1$ and the bit-length of $|y|+1$. If $r$ is one of the four work tapes, $s$ is any access-machine state, $f$ is any tape content, and $q$ lies between $-1$ and the bit-length of $|y|+1$, then the configuration obtained from $c$ by replacing tape $r$ with $f$, placing its head at $q$, and setting the state to $s$ still has every work-tape head within those bounds.
hypotheses_covered: all work-tape heads of c are between -1 and the bit-length of |y|+1
r is a work tape among the four
q is between -1 and the bit-length of |y|+1
